name: Commerce Affirm
description: Integrates Affirm point-of-sale consumer financing into Drupal Commerce.
project_description:
This project integrates Affirm into Drupal Commerce to provide point-of-sale consumer financing during checkout. Customers can order from your store immediately on credit from Affirm, paying for their purchases using a fixed monthly payment plan that suits their budget.

 In addition to the payment integration, this module provides blocks that can be used to advertise Affirm's offering anywhere on the site. Affirm advertisements on product pages use the price details to demonstrate the theoretical payment plan.
